narrative.overview: A match-night quiz on a phone. Night Ink is the room, Match Paper is the sheet, and Floodlight Lime is the one live color. Karantina sets the name and the figures. Rubik sets everything a person has to read.
keyCharacteristics: Night Ink shell, Match Paper sheet, Floodlight Lime signal
Karantina for the name and the figures; Rubik for play
One soft shadow, on the question sheet only

rules.name: The Lime Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime marks what is live or what moves the round forward. It does not fill the question sheet, an unchosen answer, or a caption.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Karantina never sets a question or an answer. Rubik never sets the home name or the final score.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only the question sheet casts a shadow, and that shadow has a downward offset.

dos: Resolve an answer with color and a drawn mark.
donts: Don't bring back the amber lower-third or a television frame.
